title: 1994 Nellis/Tonopah range video

tellings.quote: So, this is a restricted airspace uh you know, testing range. Nellis is famous.

related.note: Same 1994 Nellis video as telling 8, but explained as balloons drifting in the wind.

plain: A video is said to have been filmed in 1994 over the Nellis and Tonopah range in Nevada, a restricted stretch of military airspace used for testing aircraft and weapons. Michels brings it up himself, without naming a source, in an episode where he challenged a UFO skeptic named Mick West to a debate, stressing that this is closed testing airspace and that Nellis is famous. The point of raising it is that something strange caught on film in such a guarded place would be hard to dismiss as ordinary traffic.
